P1: After a brief cutscene, press the A Button or Start on the title screen. The player is first presented with three options, Control Info, Adventure Info, and No Info Needed.
P2: Control Info explains that tapping on the Touch Screen can be used to confirm selections and advance conversations. Different actions may be displayed with the A Button icon on the lower screen, depending on the situation. If the dual-screen icon is shown in the message window, then there are active buttons that may be pressed on the Touch Screen. The various buttons and their effects are then displayed.
C4: Moves character; moves cursor in a menu
C6: Interact with people and the environment; select menu options
C8: Cancel a selection; exit a menu
P3: Adventure Info gives background information about the player's "grand adventure". It is recommended that the player speak to everyone they find and investigate things wherever they may be, as doing so gathers the information needed to overcome challenges, solve mysteries, and discover the way forward. By overcoming the challenges posed by other Trainers and wild Pokémon, the player will grow stronger, but this is not the game's only goal. The more important objective is the hope that the player meets countless people and, through them, achieves personal growth.
P4: Selecting No Info Needed causes the famous Pokémon researcher, Professor Oak, to appear and introduce new Trainers to the Pokémon world. Next, the player is prompted to select a gender for their character, and to enter the character's name, which may be up to seven characters long. With that done, the player is transported into the world of Pokémon to begin their adventure!
P5: The journey begins in 若叶镇, in the southeast part of the Johto region. It is a rather small, sleepy town with only four buildings. The northeastern house belongs to you and 妈妈, while the southeastern one is home to your friend, 琴音/响. The large building to the north is Elm's Laboratory, where the resident researcher of the Johto region lives with his family on the second floor. The west side of town leads to the tall grasses of 29号道路, and the waters to the east open up to 27号道路.
D1:
* Elm's Lab; from Elm's aide, after receiving a first partner Pokémon (×5)
* On the spot where Silver was standing (hidden)
D2: Home; from 妈妈, after receiving a first partner Pokémon
D4: Elm's Lab; from Professor Elm, after showing him the 神奇蛋 波克比
D5: Elm's Lab; from Professor Elm, after earning the eight Johto Badges
D6: Elm's Lab; from Professor Elm, after entering the Hall of Fame
P6: The journey begins in your bedroom. The PC can be used to access your Mailbox and view any Mail that you may have received. There is already one entry stored here, a message from your friend, 琴音/响, that proclaims their love of Pokémon.
P7: 妈妈 is sitting at the table, and approaches you when you walk downstairs. She tells you that 琴音/响 was just here, playing hide-and-seek with their 玛力露. She suddenly remembers that Professor Elm has been looking for you, as he has a favor to ask, and reminds you that his laboratory is located right next door. She then prepares you to go out by handing you your Bag and Trainer Card.
P8: Buttons for Bag, Trainer Card, Save, and Options now appear on the Touch Screen.
P9: To leave the house, step on the floor mat along the south wall and press Down on the +Control Pad.
P10: When you first step outside, a 玛力露 excitedly runs up to you, mistaking you for its Trainer. 琴音/响 leaves the second floor of the lab a moment later, and the two return to their home.
P11: A young, red-haired man can be seen peering into Elm's Lab through a side window. If you try to speak to him, he shoves you back before returning to the window.
P12: Professor Elm has been waiting for you. He gives a bit of background info about his research, explaining that before the Poké Ball was invented, Pokémon used to walk alongside their Trainer, just as 琴音/响 does with 玛力露. He continues, saying that although keeping Pokémon in Poké Balls is convenient, there must be advantages to having them walk alongside people, as it may affect their growth or Evolution. Elm declares that he is going to give you a Pokémon, and asks that you let it travel outside of its Poké Ball to find out if his research is true. He directs you to a large machine with three Poké Balls to choose from.
P13: Before you can do so, Elm notices that he has received an email. An acquaintance of his, nicknamed Mr. Pokémon, studies Pokémon as a hobby and regularly contacts the professor about his findings. Elm suggests that these discoveries are not usually as exciting as they are made out to be, and assumes it to be another Pokémon Egg. He and his aides are busy with their research, so he asks that you go in his place. To accompany you on the trip, he lets you choose one of his rare Pokémon. Each has its advantages and disadvantages, so simply choose the one that you like the best.
P14: 菊草叶, the Leaf Pokémon, is the 草-type starter. It evolves into 月桂叶 at level 16, and then 大竺葵 at level 32. Chikorita gets 飞叶快刀 and 魔法叶 pretty early on, as well 毒粉, 光合作用 (to heal HP) and 反射壁 (to raise Defense's party). However, this interesting movepool has a high-expensive cost: it will struggle against most of the Gyms in the game, especially the first two ones. In comparision to the other two starters, Chikorita is probably the most challenging of the three - however, this don't mean that is a bad choice - it's great if you like strategy to win.
P15: 火球鼠, the Fire Mouse Pokémon, is the 火-type starter. It evolves into 火岩鼠 at level 14, and then 火暴兽 at level 36. Fire will have advantage against most of the Gyms. However, this good type has a cost - a movepool that isn't the best. Basically, it will rely on subpar attacks until getting 喷烟 at level 35. It can get 大字爆炎 through TM at third Gym, but has low PP and mediocre accuracy. If you don't choose Cyndaquil, you'll only get a Fire-type further after third Gym - where will have either 卡蒂狗 or 六尾
P16: 小锯鳄, the Big Jaw Pokémon, is the 水-type starter. It evolves into 蓝鳄 at level 18, and then 大力鳄 at level 30. Totodile has the most diverse movepool of the trio, getting 咬住 and 冰冻牙 pretty early on for coverage. A major advantage is due to getting 冲浪, probably the most valuable HM in the game. In comparison to other two starters, Totodile is probably the best if you're looking an easy ride through the game.
P17: After choosing your first partner Pokémon, you are given the chance to choose a nickname for it. A nickname may be up to ten characters long. The young Pokémon pops out of its Poké Ball, and Elm tells you that you may use the machine behind him to heal your Pokémon at any time. He informs you that Mr. Pokémon lives a short distance from 吉花市, to the west of 若叶镇.
P18: As you leave the building, his aide gives you five 伤药s.
P19: When you leave the lab with your new Pokémon, 琴音/响 and 玛力露 are waiting for you. She/He is excited to see the Pokémon that you chose, and suggests showing it to 妈妈.
P20: Speak to 妈妈, and she compliments your new Pokémon. After learning about Elm's task, she tells you that your Pokégear is back from the repair shop, and hands it to you.
P21: The Pokégear button now appears on the Touch Screen.
P22: She goes on to explain that the Pokégear is a handy device that every Trainer should have. It can even make phone calls by selecting the Phone icon and tapping on the name of a registered contact. The device has one contact listed, as Mom's phone number is already included.
P23: As you approach 29号道路, Professor Elm leaves his lab and catches up to you. He forgot to do this earlier, and gives you his phone number for your Pokégear.
P24: 29号道路 is a hilly path that runs west from 若叶镇 to 吉花市. Westbound travelers must pass through patches of tall grass, while eastbound travelers can jump over a series of ledges to avoid these grasses and the wild Pokémon inside. To the north, 46号道路 leads down from the mountains.

P25: The tree on the northwest hill is an Apricorn Tree. Apricorns are a type of fruit that can be processed into Poké Balls, or blended into drinks that improve a Pokémon's athletic performance. There are seven variations of the fruit, with this particular tree producing 绿球果s. These trees produce one Apricorn per day. However, it is impossible to pick any yet without a container in which to store them.
